devdoc.details: Design notes. Read these before changing anything.  1. ONE seed ciphertext per box. State and traits are not stored encrypted: they are     derived from the seed when a function needs them. The encrypted rarity score is     computed on a box's first duel and cached.  2. NOBODY but this contract is ever allowed on the seed, the score or the affection.     A holder allowed on them could decrypt everything through the relayer and skip the     game. `shake` hands out fresh ciphertexts holding one trait.  3. Owners are encrypted (`ConfidentialERC721`). Nothing reverts on ownership: an action     by someone who does not hold the box does nothing, and only they learn it. So every     shake, transfer or opening attempt is a "maybe" to everyone else.  4. A purchase is always in cUSDC, so no amount is public. The quantity of a mint is     encrypted too, and a mint creates `ids` token ids (the buyer picks 1 to `maxPerTx`), of     which only the bought ones are owned: the rest are empty. More ids hide the quantity     better and cost more gas. The number sold is an encrypted counter, capped at `maxSupply`     under encryption; a mint past the cap gets nothing and pays nothing.  5. What must become public (an opening, a duel, an alive check, an entanglement) is a     request in two steps. The request computes, encrypted, "the caller holds the box" and     the outcome masked by it, and makes both publicly decryptable. Anyone then submits the     cleartexts with their KMS proof to `finalize`. A request by someone who does not hold     the box decrypts to "no" and to zeros: it reveals nothing about the box. A successful     one reveals that the caller held it, which the action makes public anyway.  6. Milestones of the sold count are announced one by one: each mint makes the single bit     "the next milestone is reached" publicly decryptable, and `announceMilestone` proves it.  HCU per function (protocol limit 20,000,000 per transaction): see the table in  packages/contracts-evm/README.md, measured by the tests.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

Shaken(uint256,address,bool).details: Which trait was picked is deliberately absent: only the viewer can decrypt it.

acceptDuel(uint256).details: The loser's roll is selected under encryption, so the winner's trait is never      decryptable by anyone.

feed(uint256).details: A feed that was not paid adds nothing. So the number of feeds says nothing either,      and is not kept.

finalize(uint256,bytes,bytes).details: The handle list is the one stored at the request, never the caller's, so a valid      proof for another request cannot be replayed here.

params.encryptedQuantity: made for this contract and the caller with the Relayer SDK
params.ids: how many token ids to hide the quantity among, 1 to `maxPerTx`: public

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

returns.mask: bit i set means trait i is public
returns.rolls: the public rolls; entries whose bit is not set are meaningless

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

shake(uint256).details: Never touches the state roll: the five possible picks are the five trait bytes.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

_earnings.details: The holder's share of paid shakes, waiting in the box for whoever holds it.

_milestoneBit.details: "The sold count reached the next milestone", publicly decryptable after each mint.

_partner.details: Partner token id plus one; zero means not entangled.

_publicTraitMask.details: Traits made public by lost duels: bit i set means trait i is known.

_revenue.details: cUSDC the collection earned. The owner may read it.

_sold.details: Boxes sold, never more than `_maxSupply`. Nobody is allowed on it.

devdoc.title: DO NOT OPEN

InvalidKMSSignatures().notice: Returned if the returned KMS signatures are not valid.

SenderNotAllowedToUseHandle(bytes32,addr.notice: Returned if the sender is not allowed to use the handle.

ZamaProtocolUnsupported().notice: Returned if the Zama protocol is not supported on the current chain

ConfidentialTransfer(uint256,address,add.notice: `tokenId` may have moved from `from` to `to`. `moved` says if it did; `from`, `to`         and the contract that asked can decrypt it. A mint has `from` = address(0).

MintPlaced(uint256,address,uint256,bytes.notice: A mint created `count` token ids from `firstTokenId`. How many are owned is the         encrypted `quantity`, readable by the buyer.

Observed(uint256,address,uint64,uint8,ui.notice: A box opened. `openedBy` asked for it, and held the box (or its entangled partner)         then: the one ownership fact an opening makes public.

PublicDecryptionVerified(bytes32[],bytes.notice: This event is emitted when public decryption has been successfully verified.

NOT_YOURS().notice: Shake results for someone who did not hold the box (or did not pay): no trait         sits at this offset, so the app can tell.

acceptDuel(uint256).notice: Step 2 of 3: the holder of B accepts. Computes, encrypted, whether both sides         hold their boxes, who wins and which trait the loser must show, all masked by the         first, and makes exactly those four values public.

acceptEntangle(uint256,uint256).notice: Step 2 of 3: the holder of B accepts. Makes "the proposer holds A and the caller         holds B" publicly decryptable. From `finalize` on, opening either opens both.

announceMilestone(bytes,bytes).notice: Announces the next milestone with the decrypted bit and its KMS proof. Anyone may.

challengeDuel(uint256,uint256).notice: Step 1 of 3: challenges box B with box A. Only counts if the caller still holds A         when the holder of B accepts.

claimEarnings(uint256[]).notice: Pays the caller what paid shakes earned the listed boxes they hold. Boxes they         do not hold pay 0 and keep their earnings.

confidentialOwnerOf(uint256).notice: Handle of the encrypted owner. Nobody but the contract may decrypt it.

confidentialTransfer(address,uint256).notice: Moves `tokenId` to `to` if the caller holds it. Never reverts on ownership.

confidentialTransferFrom(address,address.notice: Moves `tokenId` from `from` to `to` if `from` holds it. The caller must be `from`         or one of `from`'s operators.

confidentialUsdc().notice: Confidential USDC (ERC-7984), the only way to pay.

contentsOf(uint256).notice: Plaintext contents of an opened box. All zero while sealed.

duelHandles(uint256).notice: Handles to pass, in this order, to the relayer's publicDecrypt before calling         `finalizeDuel`.

entangleProposer(uint256,uint256).notice: Who proposed to entangle A with B, or zero.

feed(uint256).notice: Anyone can feed a sealed box for `feedFee` cUSDC. The cat gains a hidden amount         of affection, possibly none. Past the golden threshold, its accessory turns golden.

finalize(uint256,bytes,bytes).notice: Step 2 of 2 of an opening, an alive check or an entanglement. Anyone may submit         the decrypted values with their KMS proof.

finalizeDuel(uint256,bytes,bytes).notice: Step 3 of 3. Anyone may submit the decrypted outcome with its KMS proof.

isOwner(uint256,address).notice: "Does `account` hold `tokenId`?", encrypted. Allowed to `account` and, for this         transaction only, to the caller. The caller must be `account`, one of its operators,         or a contract the collection trusts.

lastShake(uint256,address).notice: Handles of `viewer`'s latest shake of `tokenId`. Zero if they never shook it.

milestoneHandle().notice: Handle to pass to the relayer's publicDecrypt before `announceMilestone`. Zero         when there is nothing to ask.

milestonesReached().notice: How many milestones were announced so far.

mint(bytes32,bytes,uint8).notice: Buys an encrypted number of boxes, at most `ids`, for `mintPrice` cUSDC each.         Creates `ids` token ids either way; the buyer owns the first `quantity` of them         and can tell which from the `ConfidentialTransfer` receipts. Gets nothing and pays         nothing if the boxes would pass the cap or the buyer holds too little.         The caller must have made this contract an operator on cUSDC (`setOperator`).

observe(uint256).notice: Opens the box for `observeFee` cUSDC. Irreversible. Step 1 of 2: makes "the caller         holds it and paid" publicly decryptable, with the seed and affection masked by it,         and those of an entangled partner. Anyone then calls `finalize`.

paidShake(uint256).notice: Anyone pays `paidShakeFee` cUSDC to shake a box. Only the payer can read the         result. The holder's share waits in the box (`claimEarnings`).

partnerOf(uint256).notice: The box `tokenId` is entangled with, if any.

proposeEntangle(uint256,uint256).notice: Step 1 of 3: proposes to link A and B. Only counts if the caller holds A when         the holder of B accepts.

proveAlive(uint256).notice: Step 1 of 2. Computes the bit "is it alive", masked by "the caller holds it", and         makes both publicly decryptable. The answer becomes public whichever way it falls.

publicTraitsOf(uint256).notice: Traits of a still-sealed box made public by lost duels.

requestInfo(uint256).notice: One request. `handles` is what to pass, in this order, to the relayer's         publicDecrypt before `finalize`. `other` is the partner or B, plus one.

revealed(uint256).notice: True once the box has been opened and its contents stored in the clear.

revenueHandle().notice: Handle of the collection's cUSDC revenue, readable by the owner.

seedHandle(uint256).notice: Handle of the encrypted seed. A handle is an identifier, not the value.

setOperator(address,uint48).notice: Lets `operator` move any of the caller's tokens until `until` (a timestamp).

setTrustedReader(address,bool).notice: Lets `reader` ask `isOwner` about anyone: the collection's own game contracts.

shake(uint256).notice: The holder learns ONE trait, picked at random by the contract. Unlimited, free.         Anyone else gets `NOT_YOURS` and a zero.

tokenCount().notice: How many token ids exist: they are 0 to `tokenCount() - 1`. Empty ones included,         so this is not a supply.

usdc().notice: Plain USDC: what cUSDC wraps. Prices are in its smallest unit.

vetCertified(uint256).notice: The "Vet Certified" badge: the box was proven alive while still sealed.

userdoc.notice: 10,000 sealed boxes. Each holds one encrypted 64-bit seed drawn at mint; the cat         inside (state, five traits, rarity) is a pure function of that seed. Nobody knows who         holds which box, how many boxes anyone holds, or how many were sold: only milestones         are announced.
